note: Real-data curve sanity bands (plan 11.5.3). Bands are wide on purpose: they catch a broken feed, a wrong unit or a bad build, not a market move. A 'fail' stops the daily workflow; a 'warn' is reported. Changing a band needs its own commit and reason. Rates are decimals.

gbp_reference.note: BoE OIS and nominal government spot curves differ by the gilt-OIS spread, normally well under 150 bp.
